name: image_catvton
description: CatVTON virtual try-on (official ComfyUI-CatVTON release node). AutoMasker finds the garment area on the person (DensePose + SCHP) for upper, lower or overall; CatVTON paints the garment from the second picture into it. The pipeline loads its weights by Hugging Face repo id: runwayml's inpainting repo is gone, so the booksforcharlie mirror is used. CatVTON weights are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: only offered when IMAGE_ALLOW_NONCOMMERCIAL is on.

requires.verified: class and input names checked against the GPU server's /object_info (2026-10-14); needs accelerate, diffusers and detectron2 + DensePose (install-image-tools.sh --tryon)
